sources.label: Nai's Extra
sources.author: Nai's Extra
patch_list: Bandcamp: allows audio cache downloads over mobile data without the confirmation dialog.
Bandcamp: disables the first-party accessibility tracker that pings /api/tracker.
Bandcamp: skips the one-time onboarding overlays for the play queue, long-press downloads and public playlist tooltips.
Bandcamp: hides server-pushed banner dialogs such as update prompts, rate-me requests and announcements.
Bandcamp: turns on hidden feature flags - audio-cache indicators, podcast player controls and public-playlist track visibility.
Bandcamp: removes the free streaming play limit on unowned tralbums, so full tracks keep playing and the purchase nag never appears.
Bandcamp: always shows relevance scores in search results (admin debug flag show_search_result_score).
Bandcamp: applies the playback-rate control to every track instead of podcasts only, so 1x, 1.5x and 2x speeds work for music too.
